meta.purpose: Canonical machine-owned queue for Office_Scripts launch normalization.
notes: Keep at most two active tasks.
Use proof-driven validation on every task.
Anchor work on one reusable automation bundle instead of leaving the repo as a loose script bucket.

tasks.title: Define the first shippable automation bundle
tasks.why: The repo has a broad Office automation description, but it still lacks one explicit reusable bundle as the current delivery slice.
tasks.definitionOfDone: The repo names one explicit VBA, Power Query, or Office Script bundle as the current validated delivery target.
tasks.businessValue: Turns Office_Scripts into a reusable automation asset instead of a generic script bucket.

tasks.title: Add the automation contract artifact
tasks.why: The repo-local launch focus was still TBD and there is no accepted contract artifact for the first reusable automation bundle.
tasks.definitionOfDone: The repo has an accepted contract artifact and the launch surfaces all point at the same first automation bundle.
tasks.businessValue: Makes the automation repo easier to sell, reuse, and validate.

tasks.title: Validate the first reusable automation slice
tasks.why: The next meaningful move is one explicit automation proof slice, not more generic repo setup.
tasks.definitionOfDone: One automation bundle lands with truthful validation and updated repo evidence.
tasks.businessValue: Moves the repo toward a reusable business automation asset.

tasks.title: Capture normalized Office automation evidence
tasks.why: The repo should finish the first automation slice with aligned proof and handoff continuity.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Handoff, state, task board, and closeout all reflect the same validated automation evidence.
tasks.businessValue: Locks the repo's first reusable automation bundle into durable evidence future sessions can resume from.
